entries.title: Dismiss reviewed warnings for everyone
entries.description: Management can dismiss a needs-a-look warning once reviewed, clearing it from attention counts for everyone on web and mobile. Dismissed warnings remain faded with who dismissed them and return if the relevant hours or Travel change.

entries.title: Find connected machine readings under JD Link
entries.description: Settings, readings and hour comparisons now use the name JD Link in place of John Deere.

entries.title: Stay signed in more reliably
entries.description: Session renewal now keeps your sign-in expiry in sync, reducing unexpected sign-outs.
